solver.kind: blind AI solver B (separate agent, answer-free packet, skeptical brief)

S002-01.notes: Weighing several explanations and acknowledging limits of records = measured. Strident/dogmatic are opposites; cursory contradicts careful weighing. No second defensible choice.

S002-02.notes: Assumption (trehalose) -> counter-evidence (little or none found) -> alternative (tardigrade-specific gel-forming proteins). A wrong since the protein explanation is supported. Science is accurate (tardigrade-specific intrinsically disordered proteins / CAHS forming vitrified gels; trehalose low or absent in many species).

S002-03.notes: Text 2 agrees travel times improve at first but says congestion returns within a few years, so one-year data is accurate but too short. A contradicts 'improve at first'; C too extreme; B unsupported.

S002-04.notes: Only D shows both decay (sag with rot) and productivity (still they bloom). A decay only; B productivity only; C irrelevant.

S002-05.notes: Verified: A +3,000 (25%), B +4,500 (15%), C +2,400 (30%). Largest % = C, largest absolute = B; B states this correctly. Table data internally consistent. Others do not address the contrast.

S002-06.notes: Colon after independent clause introduces the list. B semicolon needs an independent clause after it (list is a fragment). C 'which the folding ladder...' ungrammatical. D 'forgotten and the folding ladder...' creates a garbled compound with no verb. Only A grammatical.

S002-07.notes: Singular subject 'Each' requires 'was'; intervening plural 'volunteers'/'booths' is the trap. Past-tense 'at the end of the festival' also rules out 'are'; 'have been' is plural.

flags: minor: 'they had measured' -- antecedent of 'they' is grammatically closest to 'findings', though readers will understand it as the scientists; consider 'the scientists had measured'.
S002-08.notes: 'Two' signals plural; possessive before 'findings' requires plural possessive scientists'. A singular conflicts with 'two'; B lacks possession; C nonstandard.

flags: minor: 'On the contrary' most idiomatically rebuts a negative claim made in the writer's own voice; here it rebuts a reported prediction, which works but 'In fact' or 'However' would be cleaner. Still, it is the only contrastive option, so no ambiguity.
S002-09.notes: Doubled attendance contradicts the prediction of few visitors; only contrastive transition. Similarly/Therefore/For example are all illogical.

S002-10.notes: Only A both introduces Adeyemi (who she was) and names her best-known work. B omits introduction for an unfamiliar audience; C and D omit her.

S002-11.notes: Text 2 doesn't dispute quick quiz gains but says memorized definitions are forgotten within weeks -> B. D is the main distractor but Text 2 addresses retention, not speed; C too absolute; A unsupported.

flags: minor: 'larger than any in a group' is slightly ambiguous (larger than any shell? any crab?); 'larger than any shell currently occupied by the group' would be clearer.
S002-12.notes: Each crab moves into the next-larger vacated shell, so one new shell upgrades several crabs (vacancy chain). Factually consistent with published hermit crab vacancy-chain research (e.g., Lewis & Rotjan 2009). B contradicts the chain; C contradicts lining up by size; A unsupported.
